summary.headline: Treya unlocks $1.96M in annual savings for Epika Fleet Services – $1.47M already finalized across 9 categories
summary.narrative: Through a 6-month strategic sourcing program, Treya Partners negotiated new contracts, rebates and price reductions across oils & lubricants, filters, fuel, telematics, office supplies and parts, delivering $1.47 million of hard-dollar savings that are already flowing through P&L. An additional $0.49 million is in flight from the PACCAR OEM parts program and a General Industrial Supplies conversion now being implemented. The work touches eleven business units, consolidates suppliers and establishes national pricing and rebate structures that will continue to benefit Epika post-transaction.
